fullarm:
Context from a materials paper:
- Scalable alkaline water splitting needs efficient, non-noble HER catalysts rivalling Pt
- Tuning W 5d-M 3d orbital coupling in WO2 with 3d heteroatoms should moderate H adsorption and raise HER activity
- Heteroatom M = Fe, Co, Ni, Cu (3d6 to 3d10) replacing one W of a W-W pair
- Rising M 3d filling weakens W-M coupling: bond order falls, W 5d-M 3d decouple, antibonding states fill
- Computed dG_H* on W-M sites is volcano-shaped, W-Ni (-0.43 eV) closest to zero
- Ni-WO2 selected as model catalyst on the DFT result
- Hydrothermal growth of Ni-W-O nanowires (~50 nm x ~1 um) on carbon paper
- Annealing Ni-W-O nanowires in reductive atmosphere converts them to porous Ni-WO2
- Ni-doped WO2 is single-phase monoclinic WO2 (no Ni or Ni-oxide phase)
- W in Ni-WO2 is more oxidised, with fewer occupied 5d states than in WO2
